purpose: DiffusionQC provides a quality-checking algorithm for diffusion-weighted MRIs, paired with an interactive graphical review tool for 3D Slicer.
summary: DiffusionQC is a well-structured 3D Slicer extension for quality checking diffusion-weighted MRIs. All inspection criteria are met with no blocking security or packaging concerns.

safety.rationale: No malicious code, unauthorized telemetry, or unsafe execution patterns found.

environment.rationale: Installs required packages via superbuild into dedicated python_packages_DIR without interfering with global shared environment or pinning core Slicer packages.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt and module CMake files correctly configure and install scripts, CLI executables, and python packages.

license.rationale: Includes a valid BSD-style SlicerDiffusionQC contribution and software license agreement.

soundness.rationale: Code follows standard ScriptedLoadableModule conventions and robustly handles diffusion MRI quality checking.

utility.rationale: Clear documentation, usage instructions, citation, tests, and sample data.

not_checked: Full execution in 3D Slicer runtime environment
